purpose: Replace the two hand-written simulators (scratchpad/varscan.py, scratchpad/gatesim.py) that produced every gate number in handoff/PORT_HANDOFF_PM7_BUILD_ROUTE.md with output from the REAL checkers in Concepts/pm6-build/checks/.

method.why_a_scratch_tree: All nine checkers accept the assembled document as argv[1] (check_original.py:14 is the sole exception - it resolves BUILD.parent/PMConcept4.html itself). assemble.py supports --out (assemble.py:68-74) but hardcodes PARTS = HERE/'parts' (assemble.py:23), so a u11-substituted part set cannot be fed to the repo copy without writing into Concepts/pm6-build/parts/. The whole pm6-build tree was therefore COPIED into the scratchpad, the parts substituted there, and the scratch copy of assemble.py run with --out pointing into the scratchpad. The repo was never written to.
method.repo_write_proof: git status --porcelain over Concepts/pm6-build/, Concepts/PMConcept4.html, Concepts/PMConcept7.html and Concepts/usage-concepts/QwenUsageConcept/ reports no modification from this probe; Concepts/pm6-build/manifest.json still lists 54 parts.

variants.base: byte copy of Concepts/pm6-build with no substitutions - the CONTROL. Establishes that every failure in cand-A/cand-B is attributable to u11 and not pre-existing.
variants.cand-A: the handoff's own proposal, sec 1.2/1.3: parts 15/27/47 replaced, 6 new part slots created, _shared/usage-chrome.js NOT ported (chrome dropped per sec 5).
variants.cand-B: cand-A plus _shared/usage-chrome.js in its own script part - the naive straight port the simulators actually measured.

u11_slices_used.markup: u11-prism.html:348-528 (inner of <template id="usage-page">@347-529, de-templated) + :531-546 (scope popover + 2 sprouts)

known_deviations_from_the_handoff: The handoff folds _shared/icons.js + _shared/usage-icons.js + u11-icons.js additively into the existing PM_ICONS hoist in 29x-pm6-js-globals.part.html with NO new block (sec 1.3). This probe instead gave them their own balanced script part (29x-pm6-js-usage-icons.part.html) so the substitution stays purely additive and auditable. Effect on the nine checkers: one extra balanced-zero advisory line in check_structure and one extra script block in the check_js count. No gate verdict changes.

The handoff rewrites part 47 (29x-pm6-js-usage.part.html, the PM_DEMO bridge) over the new u11 API (sec 4.1). That is design work, not a measurable transform, so the existing 196-line bridge was left byte-unchanged. It is a runtime concern, not a gate concern - no checker reads it semantically.

Part 18's unlabeled <style> block was emitted as the handoff's 'documented stub' option rather than carrying room/pane CSS, since all five ported CSS files went into the two pm6-css-* blocks. This is the configuration that MAXIMISES the check_css raw-hex finding count, i.e. the conservative measurement.

stricter_emoji_policy_verdict.verdict: REAL FAIL - 22 findings in the port bundle that check_no_emoji does not catch, because this policy bans the whole arrow (U+2190-21FF), technical (U+2300-23FF), enclosed (U+2460-24FF) and geometric (U+25A0-25FF) blocks plus a PSEUDO_ICON_CHARS set including U+00D7 and U+2212, with NO allowlist for the PARTS.md typographic glyphs.
stricter_emoji_policy_verdict.note: The handoff (sec 3.10) named only 3 of these. The dominant codepoints are U+2192 RIGHTWARDS ARROW (7, all in comments and data labels) and U+00D7 MULTIPLICATION SIGN (6), neither of which the handoff mentions. Note also that U+2192 and U+00D7 are on the PARTS.md allowlist that check_no_emoji honours, so the two policies genuinely disagree - an owner ruling, not a bug.
